Your new company     An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join a well-established technology services organisation with a growing presence in Tasmania.  Based in Hobart, this permanent role will see you supporting and improving enterprise Linux and cloud environments that underpin critical services across the state. Working closely with both local and national engineering teams, you'll play a key role in maintaining platform stability, security and operational excellence in mission-critical environments where availability and reliability are paramount.    Your new role     As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for administering and supporting Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments, ensuring systems remain secure, available and performing at their best. You will manage patching and upgrades, monitor infrastructure health, respond to incidents, and contribute to ongoing platform improvement initiatives.  Working across Azure and AWS environments, you'll help strengthen infrastructure resilience, support security and compliance requirements, and participate in a 24/7 on-call roster. You'll take ownership of critical incidents from identification through to resolution, applying strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills while working within established change management and governance frameworks. You'll also be responsible for conducting root cause analysis and maintaining operational documentation and standards.    What you'll need to succeed   
 
 Mandatory RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer) certification 
 Strong experience administering enterprise Linux/RHEL environments 
 Infrastructure engineering experience within enterprise or managed services environments 
 Experience supporting Azure and/or AWS platforms 
 Strong troubleshooting, incident management and problem-solving skills 
 Experience with patching, upgrades, system hardening and vulnerability remediation 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively 
 The ability to pass a mandatory police check 
 
 Highly regarded: 
 
 Experience within utilities, critical infrastructure, OT environments or managed services 
 
  What you'll get in return     You'll join a growing Hobart engineering team backed by experienced national engineering resources across Australia. In return, you'll gain exposure to enterprise scale Linux and cloud environments, enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, receive an on-call allowance, and have the opportunity to further develop your career within a collaborative and technically focused organisation that values accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence.   What you need to do now

Please send to:  Victor.le@hays.com.au    If this job isn't exactly what you're looking for, but you're seeking a new position, please contact us for a private conversation about your career. result.description:
Join a high-performing engineering team delivering complex, cutting-edge defence programmes   
  Competitive daily rate | Brisbane | Defence Industry | 12-Month Contract  
   
 An exciting opportunity exists for a Mechanical Engineer to join a leading Defence organisation supporting the delivery of a major capability program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will play a key role in the design, development and integration of complex products and systems throughout the engineering lifecycle. 
   
 This position would suit someone with a strong background in mechanical design, product development or engineering design within Defence, aerospace, automotive, rail, heavy industry or other highly regulated engineering environments. 
   
      
  Key Responsibilities  
    
 
 Develop and maintain mechanical designs, engineering drawings and technical documentation. 
 Support design reviews, engineering change processes and configuration management activities. 
 Produce and update 3D CAD models and detailed manufacturing drawings. 
 Work closely with systems, manufacturing, quality and project engineering teams to deliver engineering outcomes. 
 Conduct engineering investigations, design analysis and problem-solving activities. 
 Ensure designs meet customer, safety, regulatory and compliance requirements. 
 Support prototype, testing, verification and validation activities as required. 
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and design optimisation activities. 
 
   
   
  What you'll need to succeed   
   
   
 
 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Experience within Defence, aerospace, automotive, rail, manufacturing or another complex engineering environment. 
 Strong mechanical design and product development experience. 
 Proficiency with CREO and/or CAD software (SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA, NX or similar considered). 
 Experience producing engineering drawings and technical documentation. 
 Understanding of engineering lifecycles, design reviews and configuration management processes. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary project teams. 
 
   
  Desirable  
   
 
 Experience working on Defence programs. 
 Understanding of systems engineering principles. 
 Exposure to AS9100, ISO9001 or similar quality standards. 
 Eligibility to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance. 
 
   
   
  What you'll get in return   
   
 
 12-month contract with extension potential. 
 Highly attractive daily rates. 
 Opportunity to work on a major Defence capability program. 
 Brisbane-based role with flexible work arrangements. 
 Collaborative engineering environment with cutting-edge technology and complex projects. 
 Career-enhancing opportunity supporting nationally significant Defence outcomes. 
 
   
  What you need to do now  
   
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to  lauryn.reddick@hays.com.au  
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Software Engineering Discipline Lead - Simulation & Defence Systems | Victoria | Hybrid | Full-time   Your new company     
 Join an Australian engineering firm developing advanced simulation and motion technologies used across the defence sector. The company designs and builds high-fidelity driver training simulators for military vehicles integrating robotics, control systems, and immersive software to replicate real-world driving conditions with precision. 
   Your new role     
 You'll lead a team of 13 software engineers working on complex, real-world systems. Your focus is on: 
   
 
 
 Building a strong, scalable software team 
 
 
 Driving delivery and prioritisation 
 
 
 Lifting engineering discipline, quality, and assurance 
 
 
 Mentoring engineers at different stages of their careers    
 
 
 There is an established Principal Engineer in the structure. You're not expected to be the deepest technical specialist in the room, but you must come from a software engineering background. And be able to guide, challenge, and support engineers credibly. 
 You'll work closely with senior leadership and be the main interface for software delivery, performance, and team health. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 
 A software engineer by background (C++ experience strongly preferred) 
 
 
 Proven experience leading software teams 
 
 
 Comfortable balancing delivery, people leadership, and technical oversight 
 
 
 Able to step in when engineers are stuck and give practical guidance 
 
 
 Experience with Agile environments and tools like Jira 
 
 
 Exposure to safety-critical, regulated, or complex engineering environments is highly regarded. 
 
 
 Australian citizenship (eligibility for Defence Security Clearance required) 
 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 
 A growing engineering organisation with a mix of senior and junior engineers 
 
 
 A business that has tripled in size over the last three years 
 
 
 Clear ambition to expand internationally, with long-term growth opportunities for senior leaders 
 
 
 The chance to shape a team and leave a visible mark, not just maintain the status quo
